/*selectSellerMdCtChemicalMatSendList*/ SELECT REQ.REQ_NO ,REQ.BYIT_COMORG_CODE ,REQ.BUYER ,(SELECT CMPY.COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE CMPY.COM_CODE = REQ.BUYER) AS BUYER_NM ,REQ.BUYER_ITEM_NO ,DECODE(D.DESCRIPTION, NULL, B.DESCRIPTION_LOC, D.DESCRIPTION) AS DESCRIPTION_LOC ,DECODE(D.SPECIFICATION, NULL, B.SPECIFICATION, D.SPECIFICATION) AS SPECIFICATION ,DECODE(D.MAKER_NAME, NULL, B.MAKER_NAME, D.MAKER_NAME) AS MAKER_NAME ,REQ.REQ_DATE ,REQ.REQ_USER_ID ,C.USER_NAME_LOC ,C.PHONE_NUMBER ,REQ.REQ_STATUS ,(SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 COD WHERE COD.TYPE = 'CM01' AND COD.CODE = REQ.REQ_STATUS) AS STATUS_NM ,DECODE(TRIM(REQ.CMC_HARMFUL_YN),'','0','1') AS MAKE_IMG , CASE WHEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) - TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(REQ.REQ_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYYMMDD') < 3 THEN '2' WHEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) - TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(REQ.REQ_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYYMMDD') < 6 THEN '3' ELSE '4' END AS REQ_NO_IMG ,(SELECT DECODE(COUNT(PO_NO),0,'N','Y') FROM ICOMPODT PODT WHERE PODT.BUYER = REQ.BUYER AND PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = REQ.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND PODT.ADD_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-30,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AND PODT.STATUS != 'D') AS PO_YN ,REQ.QUOTATION_NO ,REQ.QUOTATION_SEQ ,REQ.REVISION FROM KEP_CMC_REQ REQ, ICOMBYIT B, ICOMLUSR C, KEPRQDT D WHERE REQ.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = B.BUYER(+) AND REQ.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO(+) AND REQ.REQ_USER_ID = C.USER_ID AND REQ.REQ_STATUS IN ('Q','R') AND B.STATUS(+) != 'D'
AND REQ.BUYER = D.BUYER(+) AND REQ.QUOTATION_NO = D.QUOTATION_NO(+) AND REQ.QUOTATION_SEQ = D.QUOTATION_SEQ(+)
AND REQ.AGENT = #{st_com_code} AND TO_CHAR(REQ.REQ_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date}
AND UPPER(REQ.REQ_NO) LIKE UPPER(#{st_req_no}) || '%'
AND REQ.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE #{st_buyer_item_no} || '%'
AND (B.DESCRIPTION_LOC LIKE '%'||#{st_desc}||'%' OR D.DESCRIPTION LIKE '%'||#{st_desc}||'%')
AND (B.SPECIFICATION LIKE '%'||#{st_spec}||'%' OR D.SPECIFICATION LIKE '%'||#{st_spec}||'%')
ORDER BY REQ.REQ_NO
